children: Oshkosh reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $2.84B, up 5.7% from the prior-year quarter, while net income declined 29.5% to $138.4M and diluted EPS fell 27% to $2.22. Growth in Access sales and improved pricing across all segments supported revenue, partly offset by production challenges in fire apparatus and delivery vehicles.
Revenue was $2.84B, compared with $2.69B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 5.7%.
Net income was $138.4M, compared with $196.2M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (29.5%).
Diluted EPS was $2.22, compared with $3.04 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (27.0%).
Access segment sales increased 20.7%. Orders reached $2.0B and backlog rose to $2.7B, supported by 2027 rental-company orders.
Pierce modernization challenges reduced fire-apparatus output. Oshkosh is working to stabilize production processes and expects new lines to increase capacity 25% to 30% compared with 2025.

Transport sales grew over the first nine months on higher Next Generation Delivery Vehicle deliveries, while backlog declined 12.8% as production continued. The company said an additional 2026 USPS order remains uncertain.
Oshkosh projected 2026 sales near $11.0B, with stronger Access sales partly offsetting lower fire-apparatus and delivery-vehicle production.

title: Oshkosh 3Q 2026: Revenue $2.84B, Net income $138.4M, EPS $2.22— 10-Q Summary
